name: bizzleap-mobile
description: Bizzleap Mobile App - Empowering farmers and small businesses

scripts.build: npm run copy-assets && npm run minify
scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist && cp -r src dist/ && cp -r public dist/ && cp *.html dist/ && cp *.json dist/ && cp sw.js dist/
scripts.minify: npm run minify-css && npm run minify-js
scripts.minify-css: for file in dist/src/css/*.css; do npx cleancss -o "$file" "$file"; done
scripts.minify-js: for file in dist/src/js/*.js; do npx terser "$file" -o "$file" --compress --mangle; done
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:run:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:run:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.cap:build:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap build android
scripts.cap:build:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap build ios

author: Bizzleap Team
